text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, let's hear it, Dants-kun! Tell 
me all about the results of your custom 
training menu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I think I did everything just like you 
asked! Though attaching a different gadget 
every time I ran was a little confusing—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I managed to carry out 
Tachyon-chan's request properly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Then let us begin data collection at 
once! Let us sequester ourselves in the 
laboratory all day long!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait... Are you planning... to 
drag Dants-san along two days in a row...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's okay, Cafe-chan! I'm curious 
about the results too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How about some coffee... for your break? I 
was actually... hoping you could try this 
new blend...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, yay!\nI'll make sure to write down 
my thoughts in a note for you again!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really now? Weren't you planning on 
monopolizing Dants's time yourself? Talk 
about the pot calling the kettle black—not 
cool at all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, listen, I'm the one who's taking up 
your time! You two both have your own 
goals to work toward, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You two are always giving me that extra 
push forward. That's why I'm so grateful. 
Thank you both, always...!
